_about: Read-only snapshot of free federal sources used to build data/ramp_stations.json. Nothing here is a reading shown to visitors.

sources.coops_predictions: https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/datagetter (hilo predictions 2026-11-28 to 2026-12-04, MLLW; mean range = mean high/low difference)
sources.jurisdiction: https://maps.deq.nc.gov/arcgis/rest/services/DMF/DBCJIW_Review_Salinty/MapServer/4 (NCDMF Current Boundaries, coastal/joint/inland, 15A NCAC 03Q .0202); point query, then 300 m if no hit
sources.nldi: https://api.water.usgs.gov/nldi/ (NHDPlus position; upstream/downstream mainstem nwissite within 40 km along the river, which is under 25 miles)
sources.usace: https://epec.saw.usace.army.mil/dsslake.txt (Kerr, Jordan, Falls, W. Kerr Scott; checked 2026-11-28)
sources.usgs_iv: https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/iv/ (active in the last 12 h for 00060, 00065, 62614, 62615, 00010)
